description: A roughly 25-million-parameter byte-level BPE decoder profile. The tokenizer is fit only on the authorized training split; validation and holdout are encoded after tokenizer fitting and never used to create merges.
execution_note: The expected parameter count is 25,110,400 if the trained tokenizer reaches exactly 512 vocabulary entries. Model Foundry must compare the actual BPE vocabulary size with this profile and reject mismatches; use a matching reviewed profile if the corpus yields fewer merges. This is not a trained model or a training authorization.
